description: 2D heave decay of a box (X 10 1, X 110; cfd_2d_heave_amr without the mesh refinement) with the free surface and the momentum of the water from the PIC particles (F 81 2, phase 3): the kernel sums of the fluid again at every step (the body moves), the level set continued into the body (X 48 3), particles pushed out of the body
covers: pic_f::support with X 10, pic_f::push_out, levelset_solid_extend from pic_f_phi
